objectives.title: Recover the secret
objectives.prompt: Recover the secret with the padding answers and get the flag.
hints: The cryptosystem lets you transform a ciphertext without knowing the plaintext.
Combine that with a yes or no answer about padding, as in Bleichenbacher's attack.
